rows.label: Formula
rows.text:
Know the difference: democracy is a system, human rights are entitlements — define both.
Support answers with one concrete example (election, protest, law) not just theory.

rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: Trick 1: Rights questions expect the three generations in order: civil-political (vote, speech), socio-economic (education, health), collective (development, environment) — structure the answer this way.  ·  Trick 2: Link rights to responsibilities in one sentence — 'every right implies a duty' — it lifts an average answer to the top band.

rows.label: Board question
rows.text: Q. What duties accompany the right to education? (1 mark) — attend and learn; respect teachers and school property.
